Insert
The
MS2OA Input module insert points provide the
means of connecting external
processing facilities into the signal path: These points normally connect to patch
panel integral to the ST series of consoles:
The inline Penny and Giles
balanced slide mixing attenuator also connects at the
insert point of the module circuitry.

Solo
The
solid state solo switches are fed from the left
and right stereo bus at the
Pan control output.
FET's Q5 and Q6 along with U7 form
solid state switch and buffer amplifier for
the
Solo left channel FETs Q7
and Q8 with the U8 form
the solid state
switch
and buffer amplifier for the Solo right channel

bus, while R125 and
R126 connect to the right Solo Mix bus.
